description: This file defines an abstract base class `CryptFilterBase` within the `PdfSharp.Pdf.Security` namespace. It declares common methods for cryptographic filters used in PDF security, including encryption and decryption functionalities, serving as a foundation for specific crypt filter implementations like `IdentityCryptFilter` or `PdfCryptFilters`.

classes.name: CryptFilterBase
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a common interface for cryptographic filter implementations in the PDF security handling.

methods.name: CryptFilterBase
methods.description: Protected constructor initializing the crypt filter, optionally from an existing PDF dictionary.

methods.name: CryptFilterBase
methods.description: Protected constructor initializing the crypt filter from a given PDF dictionary.

methods.name: EncryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Abstract method to encrypt bytes. Returns true if encryption occurred, false otherwise.

methods.name: DecryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Abstract method to decrypt bytes. Returns true if decryption occurred, false otherwise.
